evidence: Carries the Utils/log/libs label and directly modifies configuration and argument handling in src/common/args.cpp and src/common/args.h.
rationale: Eliminating IsArgSet() on ALLOW_LIST options removes an error-prone API trap that causes subtle configuration and initialization bugs. Calling IsArgSet() on negated options returned true while GetArgs() was empty, leading to improper node initialization errors such as when -noonlynet was specified alongside -privatebroadcast and -listenonion.
